register.labelZh: RUB 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: rub against 和 rub up against 可以描述貓貼着人的雙腿磨擦、袋子不斷擦着身體,或兩件物件反覆接觸。；rub down 可以表示用毛巾把人或動物擦乾,也可以表示在上漆前磨平牆壁、門或傢俬的表面。；rub in 和 rub into 可以表示塗抹乳霜或油;rub off 和 rub out 則可以表示清除污漬或鉛筆字。；rub off on 可以表示某人的自信、興奮情緒、好習慣或壞習慣開始影響其他人。
register.summaryEn: Rub against and rub up against can describe a cat touching someone’s legs, a bag moving against your body or two objects touching repeatedly. Rub down can describe drying a person or animal with a towel. It can also describe preparing a wall, door or piece of furniture for painting. Rub in and rub into describe applying cream or oil. Rub off and rub out describe removing marks, dirt or pencil writing. Rub off on can show that one person’s confidence, excitement, good habits or bad habits begin to affect other people.

contextsEn: Talk about drying bodies and preparing surfaces
Describe putting substances on and removing them
